verdict.rationale: Circle documents API-based wallet creation with defined custody semantics. Its APIs create wallets and sign transactions while Circle secures keys via MPC or passkeys, so developers never handle raw keys. Developer-controlled (custodial, wallet sets, for payouts and treasury) and user-controlled (per-user, created via an initialization challenge) wallet products cover the per-customer and per-purpose cases, available over REST, SDKs, and the CLI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deposit-address provisioning, deeper custody-model detail beyond a one-line MPC/passkey summary, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
